settings.help: Each action posts either with a Discord bot - bot token and channel ID - or through a webhook URL. With a bot the messages can be pinned and older copies cleaned up; a webhook needs no bot at all. When both are filled in, the bot is used.

On: one set of fields, used by Free Game Check and Game Sale Check alike.

Bot token: Discord Developer Portal, your application, Bot, Reset Token. Invite the bot to your server; it needs to see the channel, send messages, embed links and read the message history, and to pin messages for 'Pin the messages'.
Channel ID: switch on Developer Mode (User Settings, Advanced), then right-click the channel and pick Copy Channel ID. A pasted channel link works too.
Webhook URL: the channel's settings, Integrations, Webhooks, New Webhook, Copy Webhook URL.
[Open the Discord Developer Portal](https://discord.com/developers/applications)
Tokens, webhook URLs and keys are kept in persisted global variables (FreeGameCheck_... and GameSaleCheck_...), never in the settings file, so an exported action carries no secrets.
